source_audit.source_name: Planning applications: called-in decisions and recovered appeals
source_audit.publisher: Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government / Planning Casework Unit / Planning Inspectorate
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: GOV.UK pages state Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated; Crown copyright applies to the public decision letters and inspector reports.
source_audit.geographic_scope: England; this pass selected only clearly Greater London records.
source_audit.update_frequency: Decision-specific publication; collection last updated 2026-04-15 when accessed.
key_fields: appeal or called-in reference in title
required_caveats: Secretary of State called-in and recovered appeal records are administrative planning decisions, not construction-start, completion, opening, occupation, or outcome evidence.
Decision letters may be quashed, redetermined, varied by later permissions, or followed by conditions and legal agreements.
Some pre-2018 links are older GOV.UK or National Archives era records; verify attachment availability before final ingestion.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use for documented administrative milestones with OGL attribution, keeping decision date, source publication date, appeal reference, attachment URL, and limitations.

source_audit.publisher: Greater London Authority / London planning authorities
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: London Datastore dataset page says Licence: Not Specified. The GLA Datahub page presents the platform as publicly accessible; reuse terms need review before redistributing bulk derived data. This file stores factual candidate metadata and source row URLs only.
source_audit.geographic_scope: Greater London planning authorities, including boroughs and mayoral development corporations.
source_audit.update_frequency: Daily, as stated by London Datastore and the GLA Datahub page.
required_caveats: PLD rows are administrative application records from borough feeds and may contain inconsistent status, missing URLs, bad centroids, or backfilled historical data.
Decision_date and valid_date are planning-process dates, not real-world construction or opening dates.
Do not use PLD actual_commencement_date or actual_completion_date as construction evidence without separate verification.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use as a candidate finder and geometry/date source, but validate source row geometry, local planning URL, licence/terms, and status consistency before final ingestion.

source_audit.source_name: Greater London Authority planning application decisions page
source_audit.publisher: Greater London Authority / London City Hall
source_audit.license_or_terms_note: GLA website terms apply; factual metadata and links only in this candidate file pending fuller reuse review.
source_audit.geographic_scope: Mayoral strategic planning referrals and decisions in London.
required_caveats: GLA Stage 1, Stage 2, direction, and call-in records document planning process milestones only.
The page is useful for evidence links but often needs PDF parsing or PLD/local-register matching for application references and coordinates.
source_audit.ingestion_recommendation: Use as a supplemental evidence source when a candidate has a clear final decision/report link and can be matched to PLD or a local planning authority record.
